description: Upcoming event counts by network craft. A daily snapshot (crafting-network/event-demand@1) of how many published events Crafting Event Finder lists in the next 60 days (today to today plus 60, Pacific), per network craft tag from the network manifest, most first then by tag. Each craft gives its label, count (distinct events with a day in the window; a repeating or running event counts once), online (online or hybrid events), earliest (the first day in the window with one) and regions (a count per US state code, with online events as `online`; a hybrid event counts in its state). A child craft rolls up to its parent's tag; an Other crafts event counts under the tags its own words name; craft-fair is never a tag, and an event with no tag is left out. Counts and dates only. The answer never depends on the caller and is recomputed at most once a day.
name: get_event_demand
title: Upcoming event counts by network craft
